sections.html:
Julie brings more than 30 years of nurse practitioner experience across internal medicine, family practice, cardiology, infectious disease, and endocrinology. Her broad clinical background provides a valuable perspective in caring for patients with complex and diverse healthcare needs.

Julie was drawn to healthcare by both the science of medicine and compassion at the heart of patient care. She believes the best care comes from a true team approach—combining rapidly evolving medical knowledge and therapies with the expertise of the clinical care team and, most importantly, the voice of each patient and their support system.

She values the extensive experience she has gained outside of oncology and the unique perspective it brings to her work with patients at Utah Cancer Specialists.

Born and raised in Salt Lake City, Julie enjoys traveling, golfing, and spending time with her grandchildren.
